description: Ablation variants of the paper and the run_d2marl.py flags that produce them (added to the scenario flags of configs/table1.json).

notes.ES: removes the extended state (max waiting time, over-limit count) and the over-limit reward term
notes.WP: removes the bounded delay penalty from the reward
notes.IA: removes the intra-phase attention branch (and with it the gate)
notes.RP: plain random replay instead of stratified replay
